pathway.question: Did the new research establish missing instrument terms, and what changes in the analytical answer?

runs.text: View: no instrument-specific primary Final Terms were retained within this bounded search. A current commercial listing names a Final Terms item, but the retrieved page supplies no document link or body that can establish the missing calendar or elections. This is an unresolved question, not evidence that the document never existed. The existing conditional coupon test remains intact; exact calendar, day-count and actual step/payment conclusions remain withheld.

View: reject the new dossier as proof of the missing Final Terms. It records an unresolved document search, so no calendar or election field changes. The conditional original-principal illustration remains EUR2.5m per fully stepped year, with actual step occurrence, current balance and payment timing unknown.
